utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, don't forget the repair drive this Sunday at the community center—I'm bringing my old toaster and a wobbly lamp!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll check the tool inventory to make sure we have everything we need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I already sorted the donated tools, so the inventory should be in good shape. Let me know if you need a hand with anything else!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Ira, have you heard? Rosa's going to be at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that's great! Rosa's handy with tools. I'll definitely stop by the drive then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wonderful! I'll see you there, then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Faye, did you hear Gus has spare wrenches and a drill we can borrow? And Dane said he'd help with the steps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that'll help a lot! I'll let Sam know about the tools and make sure we're all set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks Faye. Let me know if Sam needs anything else from me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hey Dane, glad you're coming to the repair drive. Thanks for helping with my porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem, Uli. Sorry I'm late again, but I'm ready to get to work.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries, Dane. I'm just glad you're here to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I know Gus has some spare tools, so that should help us get organized.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is the repair drive definitely still on for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it's still on. Dane confirmed he'll be there, and with Gus's tools, we're all set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, I'm pulling out my tools for the repair drive tomorrow. Rosa mentioned she's coming to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive. I'll be there, but I gotta focus on the fence first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any of my tools for that fence, Bo? I've got plenty to spare.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Cleo's sorting donated tools for the drive; that should help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Dane's already on board helping at the drive too—this is coming together nicely!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Right, Rosa said she'd be there too, so that's good.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The repair drive is this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, I think it's on Sunday at the community center. Cleo sorted the donated tools already.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No, it's Saturday. Cleo is still sorting the tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Do we have a schedule for when everyone's arriving? I want to make sure we're not overlapping.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We haven't set exact arrival times yet, but we could sort that out together now if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a good idea, let's figure out a timeline so everything runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, did you hear? Rosa will be at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Rosa? That's great. Wait, what repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You know, the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday! Rosa will be there to help fix things.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you finish sorting all the tools?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Almost there! I've got the wrenches and screwdrivers grouped by size.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. What about the community center door?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Tess, I'm bringing my wobbly lamp. Are you all set for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, I'm all set! Did you see they finally fixed that pothole on Elm Street? And the garden fence is looking good too!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I noticed the pothole is fixed! That's great. And the garden fence? I hadn't seen that—did you do some work on it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, I heard Rosa will be at the repair drive tomorrow!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: True, she's coming Saturday. Good.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: So Rosa's coming Saturday for sure, right? I'll make a note of it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, by the way, I think Rosa said she'd be at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Rosa? I thought Cleo was sorting tools. Did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, maybe I mixed them up. I just remember Rosa mentioning she'd be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So we're all set for Saturday, right? I'll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, I'll check the tool inventory tonight to make sure we have everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, let me know if you need me to pick up anything on the way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Jules, I see you brought your toaster. Is that for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it's for the repair drive! I've also got a wobbly lamp I'm bringing. Are you coming on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I'm planning to come. I heard Rosa will be there too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard Gus has some tools we can borrow, and Dane said he'd help with the steps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, yeah, Dane and Noah both offered to help with my steps. And Cleo's sorting donated tools for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great that both Dane and Noah are on the steps. I'll check with Gus about those wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I'm late. I heard Cleo sorted the tools—just tell me where to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's all at the community center—Cleo's already got the tools sorted there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I'll head over now. Anything specific I should grab or start with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, I'm sorting these donated tools into categories for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Make sure to separate the screwdrivers from the wrenches; Dane likes things tidy. And Gus mentioned he has spare tools we might use.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, I'll keep screwdrivers separate. Do you know what kind of spare tools Gus has?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'm happy to lend out my tools for the repair drive, just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus! I could really use your wrenches for the repair stations—I'm sorting tools right now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I'll bring my wrenches over. Need anything else, like a hammer or screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for coming, Rosa. I really appreciate the help with the porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli! I'm glad we could get the porch steps sorted out before the repair drive on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It means a lot to have you all pitching in. I just want to make sure everything's set for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you heading to the repair drive? I need Ira to fix my swing chain.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Ira's tied up with the fence repair right now, but maybe he can get to your swing chain after?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How long do you think he'll be? I really need that swing fixed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Did you hear? The pothole on Elm Street is finally fixed, and they even mended the garden fence!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure? I thought the repair drive isn't until Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I saw it with my own eyes this morning—they must have gotten an early start!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard about the repair drive! I already fixed Mina's swing chain and helped Noah with his fence.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks for handling that! The drive is this Saturday, and Jules and Dane will be there too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saturday works for me. I'll be there to help out.
